purpose: Persist an explicit, accepted normative rule for future projects of one brand without changing the universal plugin or immutable Brand Pack artifacts.

document.revision: Positive integer incremented only for a material change
document.rules: Array of promoted brand rules sorted by id

required.id: Stable lowercase dot- or kebab-delimited semantic id
required.feedback: Short English summary of the accepted user feedback

optional.supersedes: Existing rule ids replaced by this rule

write_policy: Do not promote every project correction automatically.
Persist only when the user explicitly confirms that a normative rule must apply to future projects of the selected brand.
Keep deliverable-only changes and project rules, learnings, and patterns outside brand.rules.json.
Use the learn command instead of editing brand.rules.json manually.
Update an existing semantic id instead of adding a duplicate.
Deprecate obsolete rules instead of deleting history.
Store evidence locally and never require a plugin release for brand-rule promotion.
Preserve brand.rules.json and references/feedback/ when upgrading or reinstalling the immutable Brand Pack.
Keep brand rules untouched when the Brand Runtime plugin is upgraded or reinstalled.

versioning.runtimeVersion: Version of the installed universal engine; read from the plugin manifest
versioning.brandVersion: Version of the immutable downloaded Brand Pack
versioning.rulesRevision: Independent revision of the client-owned incremental rules
